name: RulerLevel2
description: Contains first-line indent and hanging indent information for an outline level.
remarks: The RulerLevel2 object is a member of the RulerLevels2 collection. The RulerLevels2 collection contains a RulerLevel2 object for each of the five available outline levels.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the RulerLevel2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the RulerLevel2 object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the RulerLevel2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: FirstMargin
properties.description: Gets or sets the first-line indent for the specified outline level, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: LeftMargin
properties.description: Gets or sets the left indent for the specified outline level, in points. Read/write.
